lineages.strict_procedure: Unordered selection: choose k of n by the binomial coefficient, optionally with a forced member or an exact split between two groups (product of two coefficients).
Count the non-negative integer solutions of a linear coin equation (dynamic programming / systematic enumeration of the number of each coin).
Simultaneous congruences with coprime moduli: find the least positive number meeting every remainder condition (search / Chinese remainder construction).
Generate-and-test over all candidate numbers: keep the digit strings that meet every clue until exactly one remains.
Whole-number division with floor and ceiling: nested packing (ceil of ceil), counting multiples in a range (floor of the top minus floor of the bottom), and empty seats after filling vehicles.
Polynomial pattern extension: build the table of differences until it is constant, then extend it to the asked position.
Euclid / prime-exponent comparison: the greatest common divisor, or the least common multiple, of 2-4 whole numbers.
Exposed-edge counting: perimeter = 4 x squares - 2 x (number of shared edges between neighbouring squares) for a tiled shape given row by row.
Inclusion-exclusion over 2 or 3 overlapping groups (add sizes, subtract pair overlaps, add the triple overlap) to count the union, its complement, or exactly one / two groups.
Cycle detection: the last digit of a power repeats with a short period, so reduce the exponent modulo the period, then combine terms modulo 10.
Order statistic: sort the values (expanding a frequency table by its counts), then take the middle value or the mean of the two middle values.
Minimum-cost combination: compare mixes of pack deals and single items, including buying more than needed, by searching over how many of each pack to buy.
Frequency tally: count each value's occurrences and select the unique most frequent value (or its count).
Region decomposition of a box of unit cubes (corners, edges, faces, interior) to count cubes by number of painted faces, with the bottom possibly unpainted.
Worst-case (adversarial) draw counting: an unlucky draw takes as many of each colour as it can without reaching the goal, then one more.
Prime factorisation of one number by trial division, then read off a divisor count, largest prime, distinct-prime sum or prime-factor count.
Pythagorean relation: combine or separate squared side lengths of a right triangle (ladder, walk, diagonal, perimeter) with whole-number triples.
Solve a quadratic equation arising from a rectangle (area, or area with perimeter) or from a product or sum of squares of two numbers a given amount apart; keep the positive whole root.
Unroll a stated recurrence (sum of the two previous terms, an affine map, or previous term plus its index) step by step to the asked position.
Ordered slot-filling with position restrictions: count digit strings position by position (most restricted position first), with or without repeats.
Marginal-rate accumulation over price steps: charge each unit at the rate of its own step (forward), or invert the step totals to recover the units from a bill.
